This fruit's economic importance is evident in its role in providing income to smallholder farmers and supporting local markets. However, guava production faces substantial challenges due to diseases such as anthracnose and wilt, which can reduce yields by up to 60 %. These diseases not only threaten the livelihoods of farmers but also disrupt the supply chain, affecting market stability and pricing. Recent advancements in technology are providing new solutions to these challenges. Deep Learning methods are having a significant impact on the detection and control of guava diseases, offering a promising approach to mitigate crop losses. A study proposed a novel model, InceptionMobilnet, which combines the strengths of InceptionV3 and MobilenetV2 architectures. After being trained on 527 images for 25 epochs, this model achieved an impressive accuracy of 99.90 % with recall, precision, and F 1-score of 0.9989, 0.9979, and 1, respectively, indicating the flawlessness of the model. Furthermore, Explainable AI (XAi) was employed to examine the regions of interest in the samples, enhancing the model’s transparency and reliability. Due to its low resource consumption nature, InceptionMobilnet can be converted into a mobile application, making it accessible to farmers and agricultural professionals in real-world settings. This innovative approach not only enhances disease detection but also empowers farmers with tools to protect their crops, thereby sustaining their livelihoods and contributing to the stability of the guava market.

articleTitle: Empowering Dairy Farmers IoT Milk Quality Monitoring Devices
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication and Applied Informatics (ACCAI)
abstract: Dairy farming faces challenges with traditional manual milk quality monitoring systems since it’s time-consuming and prone to errors. In response, the study presents a novel IoT-based milk quality monitoring system. In real-time, the device uses strategically positioned sensors to monitor essential characteristics like fat content, acidity levels, and microbial contamination. With wireless data transfer and central processing, the system provides timely feedback and alarms, allowing proactive intervention to maintain quality requirements. Machine learning (ML) algorithms improve the system’s ability to detect quality abnormalities, resulting in accurate and fast alerts for dairy producers. Compared to manual systems, the results show significant improvements in efficiency and specific quality parameters, including higher accuracy ($95 \%$), precision ($92 \%$), sensitivity ($94 \%$), specificity ($96 \%$), lower contamination levels ($10 \mathrm{CFU} / \mathrm{ml}$), and improved fat content $\mathbf{(} 3.8 \%$) and acidity $\mathbf{(0 . 1 5 \%)}$ measurements. The IoT-based method provides dairy producers a cost-effective, scalable, and dependable solution for optimizing milk production operations and preserving product integrity.

articleTitle: Virtual Reality-Enabled Data Processing Framework for IoT Sensor Networks with Augmented and Mixed Reality Integration, along with E-commerce, CRM, and Management Information System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication and Applied Informatics (ACCAI)
abstract: This exploratory research aims to offer a slice-edge frame that merges Virtual Reality (VR) technology with Internet of Things (IoT) detector networks, augmented reality (AR), and mixed reality (MR) to achieve greater data processing capabilities. The purpose of this study is to accomplish this goal. The framework incorporates the fundamentals of e-commerce, customer relationship management (CRM), and management information systems (MIS) to produce an output that is comprehensive in nature. The frame seeks to give immersive and engaging gestures while simultaneously handling and analyzing huge amounts of data efficiently. In addition to leveraging virtual reality, augmented reality, and mixed reality, the frame will also utilize mixed reality. Through the implementation of this integration, it is possible to enhance decision-making processes, increase customer involvement, and speed up operational operations across a wide range of industries. Throughout the course of this investigation, the suggested framework’s design, implementation, and evaluation are thoroughly examined. The study also highlights the potential for the framework to be used to adjust data recycling methods and to reshape the geographical landscape of digital ecosystems. Both of these possibilities are highlighted in the research

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Analysis on Load Balancing of Software Defined Networking using Resource Optimization on AI-Based Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication and Applied Informatics (ACCAI)
abstract: The article study applications of Artificial Intelligence (AI) within Software Defined Networks (SDN), aiming to optimize network functionality and resource utilization. Employing AI techniques can effectively manage network traffic distribution across diverse resources, enhancing operational efficiency and resource effectiveness. This paper conducts a comprehensive analysis of current practices, equitable workload distribution methods, and efficient resource utilization strategies within SDN environments. Utilizing clear plans, adaptable procedures, and sophisticated problem-solving mechanisms, the AI-driven system can efficiently address task distribution among network components, significantly enhancing performance compared to conventional methods. This study proposed an AI framework that can efficiently manage load balancing, ensuring system scalability, adaptability, and responsive growth. The proposed approach stands as an ideal solution for network administrators seeking automated, high-quality strategies to optimize resources in SDN setups that set our future directions to demonstrate.

articleTitle: Machine Learning-Based Cybersecurity Framework for IoT Devices
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication and Applied Informatics (ACCAI)
abstract: Due to their low processing power, disparate operating systems, and frequently reticent security mechanisms, Internet of Things gadgets create unique security difficulties. These elements come together to provide special security challenges for the Internet of Things. This is specifically because they are becoming less common in artificial and consumer activities. The architecture that has been provided uses sophisticated machine literacy techniques to identify and eliminate a variety of cybersecurity issues, including malware attacks, unauthorised access, and data breaches. The framework can be used to recognise and remove these hazards. The frame detects anomalies and hidden dangers in real time by continuously monitoring network activity and device gesture. This is a big plus since it makes it possible to design creative protection mechanisms. Experiments have shown that the technique is useful for improving the security of networks linked to the Internet of Things (IoT) without appreciably impacting device performance. The trials’ outcomes served as evidence for this. The investigation’s conclusions provide insight into the potential for fusing cybersecurity tactics with machine literacy to solve issues that are spreading throughout the Internet of Things’ geographic domain. This would offer a dependable solution that would protect confidential information and ensure that connected systems would carry on as usual until further notice.

articleTitle: Smart Coins, Smart Charging: An IoT-based Coin-Operated Mobile Charger System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication and Applied Informatics (ACCAI)
abstract: Mobile charging infrastructure encounters the same issues as traditional networks, such as long wait times, unreliable payment mechanisms, and operational inefficiencies. The paper presents “Smart Coins, Smart Charging,” an innovative IoT-based coin-operated system to overcome these challenges. The proposed system combines IoT technology and coin-operated functionality to provide a seamless, efficient, and secure charging experience. IoT-enabled charging stations, a centralized management system, and operator and consumer user interfaces are all critical components. The technology outperforms existing systems regarding coin acceptance accuracy, responsiveness, and user happiness thanks to meticulous design, development, and testing. Results indicate a significant improvement in coin accuracy rates (98%), reduced response time (50 ms), and enhanced user satisfaction ratings (Ease of Use: 8/10, Reliability: 9/10, Customer Support: 8/10). The “Smart Coins, Smart Charging” concept claims to transform mobile charging infrastructure, bringing ease, efficiency, and dependability to both customers and operators.

articleTitle: Enhancing Immunological Disorder Recognition through Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication and Applied Informatics (ACCAI)
abstract: The complex and varied character of immunological illnesses poses a considerable challenge to healthcare. Conventional approaches to identifying these conditions often depend on the manual interpretation of laboratory results and symptom interpretation, which may cause delays in diagnosis and perhaps misdiagnosis. Recent advances in ML have shown potential for improving the identification and categorization of immune diseases. This study uses deep learning, support vector machines, and random forests in machine learning to identify and categorize immunological illnesses. ML models can understand intricate patterns and relationships that may not be immediately obvious to human specialists by using vast datasets of medical records, genetic markers, and biomarkers. Moreover, machine learning models may be taught to constantly adjust and advance over time in response to fresh input. In addition to discussing the need for thorough validation studies and integration with current healthcare systems, this study also addresses the possible advantages and difficulties of using ML-based techniques in clinical practice. Ultimately, the use of ML approaches might completely change immunological disease diagnosis and treatment, resulting in more precise and timely treatments.

articleTitle: Cutting-Edge Technology: Exploring the Experimental Possibilities of Smart Virtual Wardrobe Design Using Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication and Applied Informatics (ACCAI)
abstract: Modern technological developments have mostly centered on three areas: communication, the workplace, and entertainment. Choosing an outfit is a daily struggle for everyone. The issue isn’t a lack of clothing; rather, it’s the inability to distinguish between those that you use frequently and those that have been in storage for quite some time. In addition to keeping tabs on your garments, a smart wardrobe can also provide outfit recommendations based on your calendar’s events. In order to assist you in deciding which garments to sell or donate, the system creates statistical data based on the frequency of wear. An intelligent wardrobe system for garment management, identification, and recommendation is suggested in this study, along with a virtual try-on system based on image processing. To test how well the suggested system works, it is cross-validated with the traditional model known as Virtual Wardrobe (VW). This system is dubbed Smart IoT Virtual Wardrobe (SIoTVW). In order to recognize and categorize the garments in the closet, the system makes use of machine learning algorithms and neural network based approaches. In order to provide the user with outfit recommendations that are suitable for various events and climates, the smart system also remembers their daily routine and clothing preferences. In addition, the system generates virtual fit-on dress models using image processing and neural network based approaches, allowing users to virtually try on various garments and view how they appear before deciding what to wear. In order to keep the clothes in pristine condition, the suggested system uses Internet of Things (IoT) sensors and application programming interfaces to track the wardrobe’s status, which includes illumination, humidity, and temperature. The system’s study reveals that it is capable of accurately detecting garments, offering clothing recommendations to users, and simulating virtual try-on dress models, which makes it an attractive option for contemporary garment management

articleTitle: Real Time Spatial Sound Scene Analysis-AlertNet
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication and Applied Informatics (ACCAI)
abstract: This project introduces a groundbreaking approach to enhance the accuracy of acoustic scene classification and ensures user safety within music player applications. It provides a combined model of deep learning by merging Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) with Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (Bi-LSTM).The model uses Mel-Frequency Cepstral Coefficients (MFCC) and Gammatone Frequency Cepstral Coefficients (GFCC) features as feature extractors, and processes these features to predict scenes.Furthermore, this paper integrates the advanced scene classification model into music player applications. Users can enjoy their favourite music while the system continuously analyses the audio environment. When a potentially dangerous situation is detected, such as sirens, alarms, or other alerting sounds, the music playback is momentarily attenuated or paused, and users are promptly alerted to pay attention to their surroundings. Performance evaluation demonstrates $97 \%$ accuracy in a noisy environment and $98 \%$ accuracy in clean environment.The CNN-Bi-LSTM hybrid model, named AlertNet, excels in capturing both fine-grained and contextual audio information. Its seamless integration into music players enhances safety and user experience. Finally, it exemplifies the fusion of cutting-edge deep learning techniques with everyday technology to ensure safety and situational awareness for users, especially in scenarios where distractions are common.

articleTitle: Detection and Mitigation of Insider Attacks in Financial Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication and Applied Informatics (ACCAI)
abstract: In the realm of financial applications relying on relational databases, the susceptibility to insider attacks poses a significant threat, with users holding administrative privileges capable of manipulating crucial entries. In response to this challenge, this project proposes a smart-contractless blockchain approach to detect insider attacks by harnessing the tamper- resistant attributes of blockchain. This approach functions as a data-agnostic framework, enabling the utilization of blockchain network for storing fixed-length fingerprints of tuples extracted from an SQL database, eliminating the necessity for a full-scale data migration and thereby enhancing the security. The project employs a formalism to intercept SQL queries and their results to ensure the integrity of respective tuples by cross-referencing with the fingerprints stored on the blockchain, which serves to identify and detect insider attacks. The enhanced hashing algorithm deployed in the technique of fingerprinting makes uses of parallel processing approach which creates an overlay- like structure inside the blockchain, which helps in reducing the computation overhead thereby detecting the attacks faster. The system automatically directs towards mitigation of the attack when an attack is detected and the tampered data gets restored to its previous consistent state upon mitigation.

articleTitle: Streamlining IoT Malware Detection:A Pipeline Based Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication and Applied Informatics (ACCAI)
abstract: Internet of Things (IoT) malware detection has become a significant cybersecurity challenge due to the expansion of the threat landscape brought about by the proliferation of IoT devices. IoT malware is growing more complex and dynamic every day, making traditional signature-based detection techniques ineffective against it. By using large-scale data generated by IoT devices to identify patterns and anomalies, machine learning (ML) techniques present a promising way to detect IoT malware. The process of developing effective machine learning models to identify malware for Internet of Things, however, can be difficult and time-consuming owing to the requirementfor meticulous preprocessing,feature engineering, model selection, and evaluation.Here, a pipeline techniquecombined with machine learning to detect IoT malware is presented in a comprehensive way. In order to increase the resilience and accuracy of the detection system, specific methods are used like data cleaning, dimensionality reduction, ensemble learning and cross validation. Standard Dataset UNSW_NB15 is used to evaluate proposed models like XGBoost Classifier, AdaBoost Classifier, Random Forest, ExtraTrees Classifier and Stochastic Gradient Descent(SGD).

articleTitle: IoT-Enabled Environmental Monitoring System Using AI
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication and Applied Informatics (ACCAI)
abstract: In light of the expansion of Internet of Things (IoT) bias, there is a great opportunity to improve environmental monitoring skills across a variety of fields, including but not limited to husbandry, civic planning, and artificial safety. The incorporation of artificial intelligence methods, such as machine literacy algorithms and deep literacy models, makes it possible to do real-time analysis and interpretation of environmental data that is gathered by Internet of Things cameras. This paper examines the approaches and technologies that are currently being utilized in Internet of Things (IoT)-based environmental monitoring systems. The focus is placed on the role that artificial intelligence plays in the process of perfecting data quality, predictive analytics, and decision-making procedures. Case studies and experimental findings illustrate the efficiency of the system in detecting and forecasting changes in the environment, which makes it easier to implement imaginative actions for environmental conservation and operation. It is important to note that the findings highlight the potentially disruptive outcome of merging Internet of Things (IoT) and artificial intelligence (AI) technologies to address urgent environmental concerns and pave the way for sustainable development enterprise.

articleTitle: Sarcasm Detection in News Headlines Using ML and DL Models
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication and Applied Informatics (ACCAI)
abstract: Sarcasm is a form of language defined using words or phrases that express the opposite of their actual meaning, often with a purpose of mocking or criticizing something or someone. Sarcasm detection is crucial for false news detection, opinion mining, sentiment analysis, detecting cyberbullies, online trolls, and other similar activities. Detecting Sarcasm is a part of Sentimental Analysis. This paper focuses on analysis of news headline to detect sarcasm using ensemble Machine Learning models like XGBoost, AdaBoostand Deep learning models like BiLSTM, CNN, RNNand a Hybrid CNN and BiLSTM model. The RNN model outperformed all of the other models with an accuracy of 0.79 and balanced F1 score of 0.76, which indicates its proficiency in discerning sarcastic content. LIME analysis is implemented to evaluate contribution of each word in a news headline towards sarcasm.

articleTitle: A Novel Evaluation on the Impact of Modern Pedagogical Tools for Improving the Learning Outcomes of Engineering Mathematics
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication and Applied Informatics (ACCAI)
abstract: The proposed research investigates the impact of modern pedagogical tools on improving the learning outcomes in the field of mathematics in engineering. The educational methodologies tend to provide transformative shift that leads to the need for efficient exploration in specialized academic contexts. The proposed work utilizes a mixed-method approach that combines quantitative assessments and qualitative analyses to evaluate the impact of modern pedagogical tools extensively. Tools such as interactive simulations, online platforms, and multimedia resources seek to integrate the curriculum involved in traditional engineering mathematics. The research study investigates the exploration of the dynamic learning process of student engagement in various learning styles. To improve mathematical proficiency in students the proposed study utilizes Quantitative measures and encompasses pre- and post-assessments. Furthermore, the research utilizes statistics derived from digital technologies to discover interaction patterns and pinpoint specific areas of difficulty or achievement. In this study, in-depth interviews and surveys to capture students’ perceptions, preferences, and experiences with the modern pedagogical tools in engineering mathematics by using Qualitative aspects. The findings of the study demonstrate the positive correlation between the incorporation of modern tools and enhanced learning results. These tools with the nature of interaction and visual appear to improve conceptual understanding and problem-solving skills. The students prioritize the flexibility and accessibility afforded by digital resources. The implications of this suggested framework extends beyond the immediate context of engineering mathematics, providing insights into the broader integration of technology in STEM education. Understanding the efficacy of contemporary pedagogical tools becomes crucial for creating a dynamic and engaging learning environment that meets modern education’s expectations as educational landscapes change.

articleTitle: Real-time Driver Monitoring using Facial Landmarks and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication and Applied Informatics (ACCAI)
abstract: Annuallya significant number of collisions stem from drivers being drowsy or distracted. The proposed work introduces a real-time computer vision setup, aimed at assessing the driver’s condition. Utilizing facial landmark scrutiny coupled with deep learning, the system identifies indications of drowsiness, such as shut eyes and yawning. Moreover, a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) categorizes driver behaviors, including smoking. Through testing on a labelled driving video dataset focusing on driver states, the proposed system showcased a 92 percent accuracy in recognizing closed eyes, 87 percent for detecting yawning, and 89 percent for classifying smoking actions. With its streamlined design and high precision, this system holds promise in enhancing road safety by continuously monitoring driver attentiveness and concentration. This research contributes valuable insights into crafting unobtrusive driver monitoring systems leveraging cutting edge computer vision methodologies.

articleTitle: Efficient Approach for Epileptic Seizure Classification and Detection based on Genetic Algorithm with CNN-RNN Classifier
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication and Applied Informatics (ACCAI)
abstract: One of the most physically and psychologically damaging neurological conditions that affect people of all ages is an epileptic seizure. The abnormality should be recognized early so that the proper treatment is timely. It is possible only with advanced signal processing techniques to distinguish and predict epileptic patterns in which substantial effort is invested. Therefore, efficient seizure detection and classification methods are proposed for machine learning and deep learning algorithms. The proposed method uses deep and machine-learning algorithms for seizure detection and classification. The objective is to analyze the performance and efficiency of deep and machine learning classifiers by comparing the various classifiers. This proposed work uses 11,500 EEG data samples from the UCI machine learning repository. To suggest an Improved Fitness Function Genetic Algorithm (IGA) technique for optimal feature selection to improve the detection rate and CNN-RNN algorithm used as the classifier. The analysis proved that the hybrid CNNRNN(LSTM with GRU) classifier with GA-based feGAbased-lection provides better densification accuracy results of 98% when compared with all other classifiers.

articleTitle: Deep Neural Networks Implementation on IoT Devices: A Practical Guide
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication and Applied Informatics (ACCAI)
abstract: Deep neural network-powered Internet of Things (IoT) devices are anticipated to revolutionise a range of industrial applications, propelled by the recent expansion of both IoT and DNN fields. On the other hand, DNNs process the data produced by IoT devices using a variety of parameters and processes. High energy consumption and latency in data processing are the outcomes of this. In order to address these problems and integrate real-time DNNs into IoT devices with constrained resources, new strategies are being investigated.

articleTitle: An Efficient Dimensionality Reduction Techniques to Data Data Visualization
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication and Applied Informatics (ACCAI)
abstract: The aim of this paper, is to gain insights in to dynamics of Kabaddi. This sport has become increasingly popular, by analyzing teams’ performance in national leagues. To do so, the results of each round of matches the participating teams play are used to create a dissimilarity matrix. This matrix is then processed through two algorithms, A visualization of the outcomes of each team was achieved by the utilization of novel dimensionality techniques. This novel approach for dimensionality reduction enables the teams’ performance to be represented in a lower-dimensional manner, facilitating the visualization of complex data connections. The t-SNE algorithm, on the other hand, captures the non-linear relationships in the teams’ performance. This study attempts to discover crucial characteristics that impact team performance and give a greater knowledge of the dynamics of the sport by comparing the findings acquired using a novel dimensionality reduction technique. The data for this study comes from the Kabaddi season that took place during 2017-2018.

articleTitle: Automated Segmentation of Brain Tumor MRI Images Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication and Applied Informatics (ACCAI)
abstract: Reason Because of its usually varied sign features, it is sometimes difficult to recognize and classify a brain cancer, such as glioblastoma multiforme, in appealing magnetic resonance (MR) images. A robust technique for dividing up brain development X-ray exams was developed and tested. Techniques Different parts of the GBM, such as localized difference upgrading, decay, and edema, are too complex for basic limitations and quantifiable approaches to adequately partition. Strategies based on generative or discriminative models have inherent limitations when used, such as limited sample set learning and movement, and most voxel-based approaches fail to produce satisfactory results in larger informative indices. Both endeavors aimed to demonstrate the intricate interplay between thought and behavior and to understand and study brain diseases through the collection and analysis of massive quantities of data. It was very challenging to document, analyze, and share the growing neuroimaging datasets. A computational approach is used to partition multimodal MR images into super pixels in order to improve the example representativeness and alleviate the inspection problem. Then, staggered Gabor wavelet channels were used to distinguish the highlights from the super pixels. In order to overcome the challenges of previous generative models, a grey level co-occurrence matrix (GLCM) model and a liking metric model for growths were developed based on the given data.

articleTitle: Machine Learning for Early Detection of Diabetic Retinopathy: Leveraging DenseNet CNNs
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication and Applied Informatics (ACCAI)
abstract: The research overcomes the limitations of existing diabetic retinopathy detection systems by proposing an innovative system based on DenseNet CNNs. Existing systems have limitations, such as manual examination, which can result in inaccuracies and time-consuming procedures. The proposed system improves efficiency and accuracy using the cutting-edge machine learning technique DenseNet CNNs. Comprehensive datasets, preprocessing, DenseNet architectural modification, and training processes are utilized. In comparison to the existing system, the results show increased performance in accuracy ($98 \%$), sensitivity $(98.7 \%)$, specificity $(96 \%)$, and F1-Score $(93 \%)$. The system’s limitations include low accuracy (97%) and specificity $(94.5 \%)$. The proposed system’s autonomous feature extraction with DenseNet CNNs eliminates the need for user intervention while enhancing adaptability. These enhancements not only improve diagnosis accuracy but also give practical benefits by automating activities and lowering the workload of healthcare workers. The development has the potential to transform diabetic retinopathy identification, allowing for more rapid treatments and better patient care in clinical settings.

articleTitle: Crime Prediction on Open Data in India Using Data Mining Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication and Applied Informatics (ACCAI)
abstract: The growth in crime data collection necessitates a deeper theoretical understanding to support practical crime prevention strategies tailored to specific locations and times. Models for forecasting the frequency of various sorts of crimes under an administrative structure of regions utilized by the Indian police, as well as the frequency of anti-social behavior offenses, are investigated in this study. Four algorithms from several techniques are employed. The information is sourced from the Indian police and encompasses over 200,000 records before preprocessing. Based on predictive performance and processing time, the results indicate that SVM may be utilized to forecast crime frequency.Additionally, an ensemble of data mining classification approaches is employed to anticipate crime. Finally, the optimal forecasting technique for achieving the most stable results is presented. The study yields a model that utilizes implicit and explicit data mining approaches to produce credible crime predictions.

articleTitle: Cotton Leaf Disease Prediction and Diagnosis Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication and Applied Informatics (ACCAI)
abstract: This project aims to investigate the application of deep learning techniques for the identification and diagnosis of diseases affecting cotton leaves, with the ultimate goal of increasing the efficacy and precision of crop health management. A sizable dataset, comprising labeled images of both healthy and diseased cotton leaves, reflecting a variety of disease stages and environmental conditions, is used in the study. During the implementation stage, preprocessing, data collecting, and model training are done using contemporary deep learning architectures. The trained model can discriminate between healthy and sick instances.

articleTitle: Fake Currency Notes Detection using Supervised Learning Methods
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication and Applied Informatics (ACCAI)
